entries.formula: current_overdue=true → PASS; current_overdue=false → latestDpdDays <= 5 PASS, > 5 FAIL

entries.formula: (min_age_years null OR age >= min_age_years) AND (max_age_years null OR age <= max_age_years)

entries.formula: (min_loan_amount is null OR loan_applications.loan_amount >= min_loan_amount) AND (max_loan_amount is null OR loan_applications.loan_amount <= max_loan_amount)

entries.formula: applicantFoir = (SUM(emi_amount WHERE account_type != Credit Card) * 12) / (turnover * 100000); PASS ⇔ applicantFoir <= foir_max
entries.docsHint: Annualised non-CC EMI vs annual turnover must not exceed foir_max

entries.formula: per CC: utilize = credit_limit - current_balance; ccOutstanding = SUM(utilize); ccLimit = SUM(credit_limit); ccUtil = ccOutstanding / ccLimit; PASS ⇔ ccUtil <= max_cc_utilization_ratio
entries.docsHint: Aggregated CC utilization must not exceed lender ratio

entries.formula: count(enquiries where date_of_enquiry in last 1 month) <= max_enquiries_1_month

entries.formula: count(enquiries where date_of_enquiry in last 3 months) <= max_enquiries_3_months
entries.docsHint: Count of enquiries in last 3 months must be within cap

entries.formula: audited_books_required === false → SKIP; true → form_data.businessDetails.auditedBooks === true

entries.formula: hasWriteOff → within 36m + settled_write_off_36_months===true → FAIL; flag false → PASS; no WO → PASS
entries.docsHint: If any open account has a write-off amount, check whether payment_start_date is within 36 months of application date
